title: Mixed Event — Resonating with you — Episode3 My Dream

meta.Event Outline: Ichika and the others learn that Shiho has been scouted by another band. Shiho is finally able to express what she's been feeling, but how will her bandmates respond?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We're Leo/need, the band Shiho currently plays in...!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Okay, now I see.
I'm Iori of STANDOUT. Nice to meet you.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Sorry, I didn't mean to scare you or anything.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Yeah, about what you just heard...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I've been trying to get Hinomori to play for STANDOUT.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: We're all set for our big debut, but then our bassist sort of just fell through.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Then I found Hinomori. She's sounds amazing and even wants to go pro...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I hate to do this to you, but I've taken the liberty of doing some recruiting.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But she's already in Leo/need.
You can't just take her away from us...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Yeah, I get that she means a lot to you guys. You wouldn't be here right now if she wasn't...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Hinomori wants to go pro, so this is probably too good an opportunity for her to pass up.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: If she joins us, her dream will come true. We already know just how good she is and I'm confident that she'll just keep growing alongside us.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: That's why I want her in STANDOUT.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: W-Wait! If we get good enough, we can show everybody just how good Shiho is too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know she has fun playing in a band with us...!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I understand that you want to keep playing with your friends. I can tell that you've been through a lot together...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: But it's not like they're focused on becoming professionals too, right? Your band right now is something they're doing for fun.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: If you come with me, we can chase after the same dream. We can walk the same path...
I'm sorry about what happened today...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Mio? What are you doing here?
The show's already over.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: STANDOUT needs people that actually want to go pro.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: We need people that can give each show everything they have and put on the best performance possible, not cowards that turn their tails and run.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Next week, we're gonna announce that we'll be debuting with a major label at Shibuya Park's outdoor stage.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: If you're that serious about becoming a pro, Hinomori, we'll be waiting for you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm sorry about not telling you guys...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This actually isn't the first time she tried to get me to join her...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is this why you seemed a little down compared to normal...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're staying with us gonna keep our band together, right...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I want to go pro and play music that can touch people's hearts.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's what I want to do...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's never really changed for you, has it, Shiho...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There's a part of me that was hoping we'd all be able to pursue that dream together...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But not all of you want to become professional musicians...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm finally starting to understand what you mean by music that touches people's hearts!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want to practice more and learn how to be as good as you, Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But do you think that means you want to go pro too...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You'll have to spend even more time practicing, rehearsing and fine tuning your sound to actually make it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Going shopping after school or visiting PXL together won't be possible anymore...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And even if you manage to go pro, your life will end up revolving around music. School, friends, everything will change...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: See? There's other stuff you all want to do...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm not about to force you into doing something you don't want to do.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! We want to play with you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We want to be in a band with you!
Forever and ever...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Again, I appreciate the thought, but that's just not enough...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You have to be willing to put everything on the line to become a pro.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Can you say for sure that you'd be able to do that?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry for causing such a fuss...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I couldn't say that I'd be willing to do that for her...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Please don't cry, Saki...
I couldn't tell her either...
